{{Quote|Oh, yes, Palpatine loved that place&hellip;|Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''Hesperidium''' was one of the four [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="CatCW" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Those three smell wrong, Lady. They are no living flesh.''"<br />"''Technically, it is living flesh, though. They're synthdroids, Ezrakh. I've seen them in the pleasure domes on Hesperidium and Carosi. Sculpted synthflesh over metal armatures.|[[Ezrakh]] and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="PoT" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|285px|The planet Coruscant and three of its four moons]]
Hesperidium was a resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and was home to several glittering pleasure palaces. It maintained a elaborate fantasy environment with [[zero-gee fountain]]s and [[singing warbleflower]]s.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had a retreat on Hesperidium.<ref name="PoT" /> [[Lovolan]] produced a lavishly decorated version of the [[R-10 household droid]] for use in the pleasure palaces at Emperor Palatine's request. A large number of [[TT-8L/XSS]] [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|gatekeeper droids]] were installed on the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="EGTD" /> Furthermore, many [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] stayed on Hesperidium during their travels to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. It was the last stopping place of the ''[[Adamantine]]'' and the [[Borealis (cruiser)|''Borealis'']] before they departed with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] for the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], for a meeting with [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]].<ref name="PoT" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Hesperidium resort moon was still in operation, though with less clientele spending [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] on travel, and more on rebuilding their lives. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] tracked [[Lumiya]] to the moon, where a vicious [[Duel on Hesperidium|duel]] ensued. Jade Skywalker was battered and bruised, and Lumiya sustained several injuries to her [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] and organic systems as well. Jade Skywalker believed that if not for the intervention of [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], she would have been successful in [[Death/Legends|killing]] Lumiya.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
